description: Analyzer output used as the architect lane input for one service scope.

fields.name: scope
fields.description: Exact target service scope for the architect lane.

fields.name: requirements
fields.description: Concrete functional requirements extracted from the user ticket for this scope.

fields.name: constraints
fields.description: Architecture, compatibility, ownership, or delivery constraints that the architect must preserve.

fields.name: nonGoals
fields.description: Explicitly excluded work or implementation boundaries for this scope.

fields.name: risks
fields.description: Known risks, ambiguities, or places requiring careful architectural decisions.

fields.name: dependencies
fields.description: Upstream contracts, services, data stores, or agents this scope depends on.
